name: Yoga school in Hong Kong
reason: No suitable school within the two-candidate limit. First candidate, Anahata Yoga (anahatayoga.com.hk, Central, founder Dr. Yogananth Andiappan), runs RYT 200-500 trainings but its own site sells it mainly on the Andiappan yoga therapy series (back care, detox, slimming and weight loss, prenatal, conditions such as insomnia and anxiety), so it fails the health-and-fitness rule. Second candidate, Tapas Yoga HK (yogatung.com, Lai Chi Kok, SYC-authorised Ashtanga), is blocked: its robots.txt names ClaudeBot with Disallow: / (10 Nov 2026; owner rule of 5 Nov treats this as blocking the whole site even though Claude-User is allowed), so no page was fetched.
